newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian call money market inactive on bank strike.
newsitem.headline: Indian call money market inactive on bank strike.

text.p: The Indian call money market was inactive with neither lenders or borrowers quoting rates on Friday because of a countrywide bank staff strike, dealers said.

Very little fund demand is expected on Friday, the banks' reporting day, but some lenders seeking to quote three-day rates said they were looking for signals from the Reserve Bank of India (RBI) before proceeding.
Bank dealers said a section of the RBI staff appear to have joined the strike.
The RBI is scheduled to conduct three auctions on Friday evening -- a three-day repo auction, 91-day treasury bill auction and 14-day treasury bill auction.
The securities market will be inactive because of the bank strike, dealers at foreign banks said.
